articles.title: Morning Kickstart: Oil falls as Saudi pipeline restarts; USD gives back early gains.
articles.expand: The U.S. dollar is mixed as North American traders arrive. It spiked higher across the board during the European morning, but has given back much of that move. Saudi Arabia has restarted its East–West pipeline, which carries crude to the Red Sea port of Yanbu.
